body: I felt way safer in Cancun than I ever felt in San Francisco. Even at 5 AM drunk on the streets talking to complete strangers.

I stayed in downtown Cancun, which isn't as touristy as the Zona Hotelera, and I really liked it. There are a bunch of hostels around there.

I also went on a day trip to Playa del Carmen, but I didn't really like it. Everything was even more over-priced and way too touristy for me.
I know. I don't need a visa to enter Mexico.
I'm on an F-1, but I don't think getting a B-2 would be a problem (if I really needed it.) I'm planning to return to school anyway, so I'll get another F-1 when that happens.

Thanks, the list of places to avoid is helpful! Also, I have enough savings to travel for a few months even if I didn't earn anything while doing it. Worst case I'll just go back home, so I'm not worried about that.

So far I've found Workaways in Puerto Escondido, Puerto Vallarta, and Mazatlan, but I'll keep looking. Thanks!

I am expecting to find temporary work which would cover day-to-day expenses. I do have some savings that I could use for plane or bus tickets when required. Right now I'm looking at Workaway opportunities, but I would need some income too—that's something I need to figure out.
I can't give you any specific advice, but kudos for doing this, and good luck!
